place.en: The hidden realm · The stone chamber

setup.zh: 第二天夜里，你打坐打到一半，隔着那道墙，听见了外头崖壁上的声音。六个人贴在崖上，一天一夜没吃没喝。
setup.en: On the second night, halfway through your sitting, you hear sounds on the cliff outside, through the wall. Six people stuck to the rock, a day and a night without food or water.

recap.zh: 第二夜，马小宝拿「你爹那三亩坡田，是谁家的？」逼着老蔫脱了袄子往上爬。老蔫冲着墙喊了一声「沈小满——开开——」。你没有动。他没扒住，掉进了左崖。
recap.en: On the second night Ma Xiaobao drove Lao Nian out of his jacket and up the rock: "Those three mu of hillside your father farms — whose are they?" Lao Nian called once at the wall: "Shen Xiaoman — open it —" You did not move. He lost his grip and fell into the left cliff.

zh: 第二天夜里，隔着那道墙。
en: The second night, through the wall.
"Those three mu of hillside your father farms — whose are they?"

story.zh:
第二天夜里，他打坐打到一半，隔着那道墙，听见了外头崖壁上的声音。

头一天，崖上还骂，还哭，还有人拿脑袋撞石头；到了第二天夜里，骂声没了，只剩下喘。冬月的秘境，崖壁凉得透骨，六个人贴在上头，一天一夜没吃没喝，只拿舌头去舔崖上渗下来的那一线水。小满坐在墙里头，那一圈五行转得正匀，外头每一声喘，他都听得见。

先是马小宝的声音，饿得又哑又低：「……老蔫。」

没有人应。马小宝又道：「老蔫。你最瘦。你那件袄子是粘在石头上的，人没粘死——你把袄子脱了，能出来。」隔了很久，老蔫的声音，比蚊子还细：「宝哥……崖是凉的，我手……没知觉了。」马小宝道：「爬上去，喊人，拿绳子来。」又隔了很久，马小宝的声音忽然换了一副腔调，平平的，不哑了，像他爹马三在村口收租：「你爹那三亩坡田，是谁家的？」

崖上再没有一个人说话。

过了一会儿，小满听见布料撕开的声音，很慢，「嘶——」，一寸一寸，像有人在揭一张贴死在墙上的旧年画。撕完了，静了一静。跟着，墙外头响起一个声音，不高，却清清楚楚，是冲着这面墙喊的：

「沈小满——开开——」

只喊了这一声。
story.en:
The second night, halfway through his sitting, he heard the sounds on the cliff outside, through the wall.

The first day, the cliff had still cursed, still wept; someone had beaten his head on the stone. By the second night the curses were gone and only breathing was left. The hidden realm in the eleventh month, the cliff cold to the bone, six people stuck to it a day and a night with nothing to eat or drink, licking at the one thread of water that seeped down the rock. Xiaoman sat inside the wall, the round of the five elements turning evenly in him, and heard every breath outside.

First Ma Xiaobao's voice, hoarse and low with hunger: "…Old Wilt."

No one answered. Ma Xiaobao said: "Old Wilt. You're the thinnest. It's your jacket that's stuck to the stone, not you — take the jacket off and you're out." After a long while, Old Wilt's voice, thinner than a mosquito's: "Brother Bao… the cliff's cold, my hands… I can't feel them." "Climb up, shout for someone, bring a rope." After another long while Ma Xiaobao's voice suddenly changed — flat, no longer hoarse, like his father Ma San collecting rent at the village gate: "Those three mu of hillside your father farms — whose are they?"

Nobody on the cliff spoke again.

After a while Xiaoman heard cloth tearing, very slowly — rrrip — inch by inch, like someone peeling an old New Year print pasted dead to a wall. When it was done, there was a pause. Then a voice rose outside the wall, not loud, but clear, called straight at this wall:

"Shen Xiaoman — open it —"

Just the once.

exits.means: stays sitting inside the wall while Lao Nian climbs and falls; does not open the binding

story.zh:
小满坐在墙里头，两只手按在膝盖上，指甲掐进了肉里。他只要站起来，走出这道墙，弯一弯腰。那一圈五行在他身子里转着，转得又匀又快，他没有动。

墙外头，响起了一下一下往上爬的声音，指甲刮着石头，很慢，隔很久，一下；又隔很久，一下。小满数着。数到第十九下，那声音停了。

然后是一声惨叫，很长，很长，从崖上往下掉，掉过了那道石台，掉进了石台外头那一片黑里，越掉越远，越掉越细，细成一根线，断了。

隔了很久很久，底下传上来一声。很轻，像一滴水。

崖上一个声音也没有。墙里头，小满坐在那里，一动不动，那一圈五行还在他身子里转，他却觉得冷，冷得牙齿磕着牙齿。第三天天快亮的时候，第五层的门开了，开得无声无息，他甚至没有觉得疼。

第五层的门开了以后，石室里的灵气还厚着。他心里算了一笔账：再吸半天，第六层的门槛也许便摸得着了。他便又吸了一口。这一口吸下去，他觉出不对来了：丹田里那一圈转，慢了，沉了，像灶膛里柴塞得太满，火闷住了，只冒烟，不起焰；他再吸，那灵气便在经脉里堵着，胀得他胸口发闷，太阳穴一跳一跳地疼。

胸口的木牌凉凉地贴着他，一个很困的声音在他耳朵里道：「够了。」小满道：「还没够。再吸半天，就六层了。」那声音道：「……你娘给你起的名字，叫什么？」小满愣了一愣。他想起过年那天夜里，他坐在柴垛上，他娘在窗户里头拨着算盘，给他讲他这个名字：满了就要溢出来，溢出来就糟践了；饱了一点，还没满，还知道饿。知道饿，才知道别人也饿。他慢慢地，把那口还没吸完的气吐了出去。吐出去的那一刻，胸口一松，像从塞满的灶膛里抽出一根柴，风钻进去，火苗子「呼」地蹿了起来——那一圈又转了，轻快，匀。石室里的灵气还厚厚地积着，他只舀走了浅浅的一层；剩下的，留给它自己。便在这时，隔着那面墙，崖壁上传来马小宝的声音，饿得又哑又低，却一个字一个字地钻进来：「……沈小满。你在里头喘气，我听得见。」
story.en:
Xiaoman sat inside the wall, both hands on his knees, nails driven into the flesh. He had only to stand, walk out through the wall, and bend down. The round of the five elements turned in him, even and quick; he didn't move.

Outside the wall came the sound of climbing, one pull at a time, fingernails scraping stone, very slow, a long gap, one; another long gap, one. Xiaoman counted. At nineteen, the sound stopped.

Then a scream, long, very long, falling from the cliff, falling past the ledge into the black beyond it, further and further, thinner and thinner, thin as a thread, and snapped.

After a long, long time, a sound came up from below. Very faint, like a drop of water.

Not a sound on the cliff. Inside the wall Xiaoman sat motionless; the round of the five elements still turned in him, yet he was cold, so cold his teeth knocked together. Near dawn of the third day the gate of layer five opened, silently, and he didn't even feel it hurt.

After the gate of layer five opened, the qi in the chamber was still thick. He reckoned: another half day and he might touch the threshold of layer six. So he drew another breath. And with it he felt something wrong: the ring turning in his dantian slowed, grew heavy, like a firebox stuffed too full of wood, the fire smothered, all smoke and no flame; he drew again, and the qi jammed in his meridians, swelling till his chest ached and his temples throbbed.

The token lay cool against him, and a very sleepy voice said in his ear: "Enough." "Not yet. Another half day and it's layer six." "…What name did your mother give you?" Xiaoman was taken aback. He remembered New Year's night, himself on the woodpile and his mother at the window working her abacus, telling him about his name: full to the brim spills over, and what spills is wasted; a little full, not yet brimming, still knows hunger. Know hunger, and you know others are hungry. Slowly he let out the breath he hadn't finished drawing. As it left him his chest eased — like pulling one stick from a stuffed firebox: the draught gets in and the flame leaps up — and the ring turned again, light and even. The qi in the chamber still lay thick; he had skimmed only a thin layer. The rest he left to it. Just then, through the wall, came Ma Xiaobao's voice from the cliff, hoarse and low with hunger, boring in word by word: "…Shen Xiaoman. I can hear you breathing in there."
